command: cargo nextest run --locked --no-fail-fast >/tmp/s101_suite.log 2>&1; echo "NEXTEST_EXIT=$?"; tail -1 /tmp/s101_suite.log; echo "===warnings on clean build==="; cargo build --locked 2>&1 | grep -c "warning"; echo "===clippy (targeted, -D warnings)==="; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E "^warning|^error" | head; echo "CLIPPY_DONE"
